submissions.title: Optic Pathway Glioma: Clinical Masterclass
submissions.summary: Optic Pathway Gliomas (OPGs) are low-grade astrocytic tumors affecting the optic nerve, chiasm, and post-chiasmatic tracts, predominantly occurring in young children. Strongly associated with Neurofibromatosis Type 1 (NF1), management balances preservation of visual function, endocrine stability, and tumor control through multi-disciplinary care.
